Royal dinner tonight at {murder_time} in the dining room.
Dinner is at {murder_time} sharp. The King hates waiting.
Menu for tonight's royal dinner, to be served at {murder_time}.
Everyone will be at the table at {murder_time} tonight, so the silver must be polished.
The table is already set for dinner. A small card on the King's plate reads "{murder_time}".
Dinner at {murder_time} again. Father won't wait a single minute for anyone.
An empty vial with a skull label, hidden behind the wine barrels.
One wine bottle has a broken seal that was closed again with fresh wax.
A book about poisons, left open at the page on poisons that cannot be tasted in wine.
A dead mouse lies next to a small puddle of spilled wine.
Someone took the nightshade berries from the alchemy room. Nasty stuff.
A wine glass that smells oddly bitter, as if something was mixed in it.
Someone took a bottle of foxglove from my cabinet this morning.
Someone tore the page about poisons out of the herbal book.
Someone wanted to know which poisons can't be tasted in wine. When I said I had no idea, they left in a hurry.
{excluded} spent the whole afternoon with me in the staff room, counting linen. They never left my sight.
{excluded} dropped a whole tray of glasses this morning. I've banned them from my kitchen until tomorrow.
{excluded} can't stand the smell of wine. One sniff and they leave the room.
My men keep an eye on the dining room before a royal dinner. Only {partial_list} went in there this afternoon.
Seating plan: wine to be poured for {list}.
Juice for the princess. She never drinks wine.
I love a little taste of the wine before it goes to the table.
I've forbidden {excluded} to touch wine. Doctor's orders.
{excluded} sent back their wine at lunch. Said it tasted of vinegar and they won't touch another drop today.
{excluded} bet me this morning that they can go without wine until the ball. I'm watching them like a hawk.
A dropped note without a name: "{murder_place}. {murder_time}. Come alone, and burn this letter."
Someone asked me if anyone uses {murder_place} around {murder_time}. I told them nobody ever goes there.
Torn draft in the library waste basket: "...{murder_place} at {murder_time}... tell no one..."
A candle and two cups are set out in {murder_place}. A scrap of paper next to them reads "{murder_time}".
I heard someone whisper '{murder_time}, {murder_place}' behind the library door.
One of my knives is missing from the drawer.
A dagger is hidden in {murder_place}.
One of my daggers is missing from the rack.
An empty dagger sheath lies on the armory floor.
Someone asked me today whether a small puncture in the aorta would be fatal. Strange question.
Someone used my grindstone before sunrise. Put an edge on something small, by the look of the dust.
A sheet of my best paper and a stick of sealing wax are gone from my desk. Whoever took them didn't want to use their own.
Two cups and a jug of cider have gone missing from my kitchen. Someone is planning a private little talk tonight.
As far as I know, only {list} can write.
{excluded} cut their writing hand this morning. They can't hold a pen today.
{list} are the only ones who ever ask me for paper and ink.
The duty roster on the guards room door is signed with a cross by the Head Guard.
Every week someone has to read the orders to me. I never learned my letters.
Someone used my desk to write a letter today. It wasn't {excluded}, they were with me all afternoon.
Library loan book: books borrowed this month by {list}.
I delivered sealed letters today to {partial_list}.
Notice on the armory door: "Orders for the Weapons master must be read out to him."
Someone's getting secret letters! I saw {partial_list} each reading something in a corner today.
{excluded} broke their reading glasses this morning. They can't read a word until I've ground them a new pair.
Tea schedule on the kitchen wall: "Evening tea in the parlor, {murder_time}."
Tea for one, in the parlor, at {murder_time}. And I am expected to work miracles with a single scone.
The tea table is set for one: a single cup, and a card reading "{murder_time}".
I was asked to have the parlor ready by {murder_time}.
Note on the parlor door: "Reserved from {murder_time}. Please do not disturb."
Tea at {murder_time} in the parlor is a castle tradition. Whoever's turn it is gets an hour of peace.
A saw lies on the floor by the parlor gallery.
My best saw went out on loan this morning and hasn't come back.
I was asked how much our old chandeliers weigh. I had to look it up. More than a horse, it turns out.
Someone wanted to know how the parlor chandelier is hung. One rope, I told them, tied off up at the balustrade.
Someone borrowed the old book on how this castle was built. The one with the drawings of the chandeliers.
Someone told my men to keep off the parlor gallery tonight. Said the railing is being repaired.
Today I saw {partial_list} up at the parlor gallery.
{excluded} burned both hands on a hot pan this morning. They can't grip a thing today.
{excluded} cut their palm on one of my knives this morning. A deep cut. They can't close that hand for the rest of the day.
Someone took my best saw during the sword lesson just before lunch. It wasn't {excluded}: I had them in front of me the whole lesson.
Only {partial_list} were in my workshop this morning. One of them walked out with my saw.
Only {list} ever take tea in the parlor. The rest of this household has no taste.
Tea order book: tea served in the parlor this week to {partial_list}.
{excluded} never drinks tea. Wine, or nothing at all.
{excluded} despises tea. Called the blend I prepare dishwater. Not that I touch the stuff myself.
{excluded} had their turn at the parlor tea yesterday. It won't come round to them again tonight.
Note on the library door: "Quiet reading hour from {murder_time}. Do not disturb."
I was asked to make sure the library is empty by {murder_time}.
Reading in the library at {murder_time}, just as my dinner reaches its climax. Some people have no sense of timing.
A reading lamp is already lit at the corner desk, next to a card reading "{murder_time}".
The library is quietest at {murder_time}. That's when people come to read alone.
The Great Chronicle of the Realm is gone from its shelf. Nobody ever borrows it. It's far too heavy to casually carry around.
This morning someone in the library was weighing books in their hands, one after another. They didn't read a single one.
Someone asked me to fit the Great Chronicle with iron corners. As if it weren't heavy enough already.
Someone borrowed my kitchen scales this morning. They came back covered in old parchment dust. My scales are for flour, not for literature.
Someone came to me this morning with a broken toe. Dropped a book on it, they said. Must have been a monster of a book.
Someone moved the Great Chronicle to the shelf right above the corner reading desk. That book has stood in the same place since before I was born.
Someone asked me to keep my men away from the library tonight. 'People want to read in peace,' they said.
{excluded} has the arms of a sparrow. I've seen them struggle with a bread basket.
{excluded} couldn't swing anything heavier than a quill.
{partial_list} helped carry the heavy chests for the ball this week. Strong backs, all of them.
{excluded} threw out their back this morning. Doctor's orders: nothing heavier than a spoon today.
The Head of household, the Princess and the Queen can't even lift my big soup pot.
{excluded} lost an arm-wrestle to the kitchen boy this morning. Not a muscle on them.
Library loan book: books borrowed today by {partial_list}.
The Weapons master can't read a word. I read him his orders myself.
Note on the library desk: "Reading desk reserved today by: {partial_list}."
{excluded} broke their reading glasses this morning. They can't read a word until I've ground them a new pair.
{excluded} returned every book they had this morning. Said they're done with reading for a while.
{excluded} asked for supper in their room at {murder_time} tonight.
Note on the throne room door: "Rehearsal for the ball procession, {murder_time}."
There's a rehearsal for the ball in the throne room at {murder_time} tonight. I'll make sure the room stays lit.
Rehearsal in the throne room at {murder_time}, and I've been told to keep my men out of the room for it.
Dinner waits until after the rehearsal in the throne room at {murder_time}. My soufflé will never forgive them.
A rehearsal for the procession in the throne room at {murder_time}. As if anyone needs practice walking in a line.
Notice: "All who walk in the ball procession: throne room, {murder_time}."
One of my crossbows is missing from the rack, and nobody asked me for it.
Someone took three crossbow bolts from the practice targets this week. Those things are sharp.
I get a lot of requests every day. The one that stood out the most today was the need for a chair on the gallery of the throne room. Nobody ever sits up there.
Someone has been shooting at the old targets in the guards wing all morning. I could hear it from the study.
Someone moved the big candelabra away from the throne room gallery. It's dark up there in the evenings now.
How far does a crossbow bolt fly before it drops? That's what I was asked today. Further than you'd think, I said.
{partial_list} were at archery practice this week.
{partial_list} rode out hunting with me this morning.
{excluded} woke up with a nasty eye infection this morning. They can barely see across a room today.
{partial_list} have borrowed crossbows from the guards' store this month.
The Doctor, the Librarian and the Head of household have never held a crossbow in their lives. I offered to teach them. They laughed.
{excluded} crushed two fingers of their shooting hand in the armory door this morning. I don't think they'll be able to use their hands today.
{partial_list} asked me this morning to have their best clothes pressed for the procession.
{excluded} won't be at the rehearsal tonight. They told me so themselves.
I hear {partial_list} are among those walking in the procession tonight. They'll all want supper after.
{excluded} asked to be left out of the procession tonight.
I've excused {excluded} from tonight's rehearsal. They know the steps well enough.
Note on the infirmary door: "Evening remedies at {murder_time}. Take your own bottle from the cabinet."
At {murder_time} everyone comes for their evening remedy. I can't hand them all out, so they take their own bottle from the cabinet.
Supper waits until after {murder_time}, when half the castle is queuing at the infirmary. Again.
The Doctor asked me to send anyone who feels unwell to the infirmary at {murder_time}.
At {murder_time} my men go for their remedies. Bruises and coughs, every evening.
I noticed the bottles in my cabinet have been moved. Some labels are turned the wrong way round.
Someone asked me what 'aqua' and 'venenum' mean. Water and poison, I told them.
Three of my jam jars have lost their labels. Soaked clean off this morning. Who does that?
Someone asked me when there's nobody in the infirmary. I told them: never for long.
Someone tore a page out of my book of poisons. The book was back on the shelf, but the page is gone.
One of the Doctor's little bottles is gone from the drying rack. I counted them myself this morning.
Someone asked me today which of my bottles would kill a man the fastest. Said it was for a story.
I keep a list of people who take a remedy in the evening. This morning I found it in the wrong drawer. Someone must've read it and put it back.
As far as I know, the Weapons master is the only one in the castle who can't read.
Someone read the Doctor's herb book at my desk at midday. It wasn't {excluded}, they were helping me shelve books then.
{excluded} sprained both wrists at sword practice this morning. They can't hold a cup, let alone a little bottle.
{excluded} sat on their reading glasses this morning. They can't read a thing until the Doctor grinds new ones.
My cabinet was in perfect order when I went to lunch, and wrong when I came back. It wasn't {excluded}: they sat across from me the whole meal.
Tonight {partial_list} come for their evening remedy.
{excluded} refused my remedy this morning. Said they'd rather be ill than drink my muck.
{partial_list} asked me for honey and hot water this morning. There's a sore throat going around.
{excluded} already took their remedy at noon. They won't need another tonight.
{excluded} told me this morning they haven't felt this well in years. They've stopped taking the Doctor's remedies.
A torn scrap of paper: "...{murder_time}, by the old bridge on the forest road..."
Someone asked me which of my men patrols the forest road at {murder_time}. None, I told them.
Someone asked me when it gets dark in the forest these days. 'By {murder_time},' I said.
The last cart from the village comes up the forest road before {murder_time}. After that, the road is empty.
My last patrol rides back up the forest road at {murder_time}. This morning someone paid one of my men to take the long way round tonight.
A heavy club is gone from my practice rack since this morning. The light ones are all still there.
Someone borrowed the old map of the forest paths. The one with all the shortcuts.
Someone asked me to pack some food 'for a long wait in the cold'. An odd request.
Someone asked me how far from the walls a voice can still be heard. Not even as far as the forest, I told them.
My heaviest rolling pin is gone. Nobody bakes with it but me.
This morning I was asked, 'Who leaves the castle tonight?' I answered before I wondered why anyone would ask.
The Head of household, the Princess and the Queen can't even lift my big soup pot.
{excluded} has the arms of a sparrow. I've seen them struggle with a bread basket.
{excluded} couldn't swing anything heavier than a quill.
{excluded} threw out their back this morning. Doctor's orders: nothing heavier than a spoon today.
{excluded} lost an arm-wrestle to the kitchen boy this morning. Not a muscle on them.
{excluded} twisted an ankle on the stairs this morning. They can't walk further than the kitchen today.
{excluded} told me they're staying in tonight. They got soaked to the bone this morning and have had enough.
{excluded} has a fever. I've told them not to set one foot outside today.
{excluded} asked me to send a rider to the village with a message. They won't go themselves tonight.
{excluded} will be sitting with the Queen by the fire tonight. Nobody goes out in weather like this.
{excluded} promised to help me hang the new shields in the armory tonight. That'll take all evening.
Someone came to me for a sleeping draught for tonight. Don't ask who, that stays between us. They'll be sound asleep by {murder_time}.
At {murder_time} my men change shifts. For a few minutes nobody walks the castle halls.
I heard someone whisper '{murder_time}, they'll be asleep' near the bedrooms.
After {murder_time} my men stop walking the bedroom corridor. From then on there isn't a soul in the halls.
The torches in the bedroom hallway go out at {murder_time} tonight. Someone told my maid to do it early. Not me.
The big feather pillow has left my linen cupboard today. An extra one, 'for comfort', I was told.
The hinges of all bedroom doors have been oiled. Don't know who did it, but they did a great job, not a single squeak left.
Someone borrowed the old physician's handbook today. They left a ribbon at the chapter on breathing.
The list of my night guards' rounds went missing this morning. It turned up again at lunch, folded the wrong way.
Someone asked me which floorboards near the bedrooms creak. I know every one of them.
Someone asked me whether you can hear through the bedroom doors. You can't. Believe me, I've tried.
The Head of household, the Princess and the Queen can't even lift my big soup pot.
{excluded} has the arms of a sparrow. I've seen them struggle with a bread basket.
{excluded} couldn't swing anything heavier than a quill.
{excluded} threw out their back this morning. Doctor's orders: nothing heavier than a spoon today.
{excluded} lost an arm-wrestle to the kitchen boy this morning. Not a muscle on them.
The Doctor, the Librarian and I are the only ones without a bedroom of our own.
{excluded} asked me for something to keep them awake tonight. They want to finish a letter before morning.
{excluded} wants a jug of strong tea at nine tonight. They'll be up half the night.
{excluded} can't sleep a wink with that toothache. I gave them clove oil, but I suspect it won't be that effective. They'll probably be up all night.
{excluded} asked to stand the night watch with my men tonight. Wants to know what it's like. Cold, mostly.
Twice today I was asked who has {murder_place} at {murder_time}. I keep the list. I'm not a town crier.
My kitchen boys carry the hot water to {murder_place} just before {murder_time}. Today someone wanted to know exactly how long they stay. Not a minute, I said.
Around {murder_time} my men change shifts today, and nobody is upstairs for a little while. I told someone so this morning. They wanted to know, no clue why.
A torn scrap of paper: "...{murder_place}, {murder_time}. Wait until the kitchen boys have gone..."
The clean towels for {murder_place} are supposed to go up at {murder_time}, but this morning someone took them off my list and said they'd carry them up themselves.
Got a strange question today: how long can a man hold his breath? I said I'd never tried. They looked disappointed.
Someone asked me if a hot bath makes you drowsy. Very, I said. I fall asleep in mine every time.
The walls of {murder_place} are a foot thick. This morning someone made me stand outside while they shouted in there. I heard nothing at all.
Is there a window that looks into {murder_place}? That's what I was asked today. None, I said. Why would anyone want to look in there?
My kitchen boys were told to fill the tub to the very brim tonight. 'Deeper than usual,' was the order.
The Head of household, the Princess and the Queen can't even lift my big soup pot.
{excluded} has the arms of a sparrow. I've seen them struggle with a bread basket.
{excluded} couldn't swing anything heavier than a quill.
{excluded} threw out their back this morning. Doctor's orders: nothing heavier than a spoon today.
{excluded} lost an arm-wrestle to the kitchen boy this morning. Not a muscle on them.
{excluded} burned both hands on the soup pot this morning. I've told them not to grip anything today.
{excluded} cut their leg on the stairs this morning. No bathing until it has closed, Doctor's orders.
{excluded} asked me for a bowl of warm water in their room tonight. They washed in the bathroom this morning, and once a day is enough for them.
{excluded} fell headfirst into the horse trough this morning. Came up spluttering and said, 'Well, that's my bath for today.' I laughed so hard I had to sit down.
{excluded} has a rash from the new soap. I've told them to keep away from bath water until it's gone.
{excluded} had my kitchen boys carry up hot water at noon. They've had their bath for today.
A scrap of paper: "...{murder_place}, {murder_time}. Their back will be to the door..."
I heard a whisper on the stairs this morning: '{murder_place}, {murder_time}. They won't even look up.'
One of my men was offered good money to skip his round past {murder_place} at {murder_time}. He came straight to me. Good lad.
Tonight a maid was supposed to bring fresh candles to {murder_place} at {murder_time}. Someone sent her home with a coin and a smile. Not me. I'd like to know who did that.
Note on the door of {murder_place}: "Do not disturb {victim} after {murder_time}."
Someone took a bowstring from my workbench this morning. Just the string. The bow is still there.
Someone cut the cord off the curtains in the guest room. A clean cut, too.
Someone took the long cord I tie the hams with. Who steals string?
Someone took the silk sash from my ball gown. The long one.
Someone asked me to show them the hold we use on drunks. From behind, around the neck.
The cord that ties up my big map scrolls is gone. I found the maps unrolled all over the floor this morning.
The Head of household, the Princess and the Queen can't even lift my big soup pot.
{excluded} has the arms of a sparrow. I've seen them struggle with a bread basket.
{excluded} couldn't swing anything heavier than a quill.
{excluded} threw out their back this morning. Doctor's orders: nothing heavier than a spoon today.
{excluded} lost an arm-wrestle to the kitchen boy this morning. Not a muscle on them.
{excluded} sprained both wrists falling off a horse this morning. They can't even hold a cup today.
{excluded} burned their hands on my bread oven this morning. I put cold butter on it. The Doctor says that was wrong.
{excluded} cut their palm on a blade this morning. Deep. They shouldn't grip anything today.
{excluded} and I are playing dice in the guards room at {murder_time}. I'm winning my money back.
{excluded} asked for a guard at their door tonight. They wouldn't say why.
{excluded} hurt their knee this morning. I'm checking up on them every half hour tonight.
{excluded} promised to play cards with me and my maids all evening. They don't know yet that I cheat.
{excluded} has cancelled everything tonight and sits with my maids in the staff room, mending sheets. Said they wanted company.
{excluded} promised to help me move the old chronicles to the top shelves tonight. That'll take all evening.
Study reserved for {victim} from {murder_time}.
{victim} has the study to themselves from {murder_time} tonight. They don't want a maid near the hearth, they'll light the fire themselves.
{victim} told my men that nobody goes into the study after {murder_time} tonight.
{victim} is shutting themselves in the study at {murder_time} tonight. Don't knock, they said.
A small keg of black powder is missing from the armory. I counted twice.
The whole study smells of rotten eggs, and it's coming from the hearth.
Someone has been at the woodpile. There's a heap of fresh shavings, as if a log was hollowed out.
Someone took the hand drill from my workbench and put it back full of sawdust.
One of my men saw someone carry a single log into the study this afternoon. The maids had already brought the wood.
Only {partial_list} came into the armory today.
My men walked past the study all day. Only {partial_list} went in.
{excluded} sat with me in the library the whole day. They never left my sight.
{excluded} sprained both wrists falling off a horse this morning. They can't even hold a cup.
{excluded} is helping me with the ball tonight. They won't sit down for a minute.
{excluded} knocked over all my paperwork in the study this morning, it took an hour to sort it all out. I told them they're not to set foot in there again today.
{excluded} wanted the study tonight, and I said no. The ball comes first.
{excluded} promised to help me scrub the big pots tonight. That takes until bedtime.
A written coronation speech in the handwriting of {suspect}.
Letter from {victim} to {suspect}: "I know what you did. Pay me by tomorrow, or everyone else will know too."
A note: {suspect} owes {victim} 100 gold coins, to be paid before tomorrow.
{suspect} is madly in love, but their sweetheart only has eyes for {victim}. You should have seen {suspect}'s face this morning.
Order signed by {victim}: "{suspect} is fired tomorrow."
{victim} mocked {suspect} in front of the whole court this morning.
Marriage contract signed by {victim}: {suspect} must marry a foreign noble next month.
Letter from {suspect} to {victim}: "You haven't paid me for the past six months. This is my last warning."
Order: "{suspect} has failed for the last time. From tomorrow, {victim} takes over all their duties."
Draft of {victim}'s will: "{suspect} receives nothing."
Royal decree signed by {victim}: "All experiments in the infirmary are forbidden. If caught, {suspect} will be banished."
Doctor's lab journal: "Experiment 14. Subject: {suspect}, who was perfectly healthy. Secretly mixed my new potion into their tea. Side effects: hair loss, nightmares. Fascinating!"
Ever since the silver went missing, {victim} hasn't taken their eyes off {suspect}.
Letter signed by {victim}: "{suspect} may never marry a servant. The servant leaves the castle tomorrow."
{victim} threw the book {suspect} spent ten years writing into the fire.
{victim} tells everyone that {suspect} is a thief. Nobody trusts {suspect} anymore.
{victim} saw {suspect} selling the crown's weapons to our enemies across the border.
Letter from {victim} to {suspect}: "Pay me, or the whole court learns how deep in debt you are."
{suspect} said it out loud: the foreign queen will be the ruin of this kingdom.
{victim} keeps warning everyone that {suspect} is a hedge-witch's son who practises witchcraft in the castle.
{victim} spat out {suspect}'s soup in front of the whole court and called it pig slop.
{victim} laughed in front of the whole court that {suspect}'s sword has gathered more dust than glory.
{victim} keeps the household books. She told {suspect} to their face that the numbers don't add up, and that she'll report it tomorrow.
Letter from {victim} to {suspect}: "I know how you really became Master Chef. The old cook didn't fall down those stairs by accident."
{victim} wants a kitchen girl thrown in the dungeon for breaking a cup. {suspect} begged, but {victim} wouldn't listen.
{victim} found out that {suspect} let a stranger into the castle last week, and threatens to tell the King.
{suspect} said the crown should never go to someone as weak as {victim}.
{victim} wants to drive a poor family off the castle lands. {suspect} swore they'd stop it, whatever it takes.
{victim} has been telling the whole court an embarrassing secret about {suspect}. She is furious.
{victim} keeps pushing the King to march on {suspect}'s homeland.
{suspect} is convinced {victim} will use them in his next experiment. They can't sleep anymore.
{suspect} found out that {victim} sells weapons to our enemies. A traitor, he calls him.
{victim} knows {suspect}'s secret, and she can never keep her mouth shut.
Doctor's lab journal: "Experiment 15 requires blood from {victim}. A rare type, and a few drops will not do. It must be obtained soon."
{victim} caught {suspect} reading a forbidden book of dark magic, and wants to tell the King.
{victim} found something in the royal archives about {suspect}'s real parents.
{victim} read {suspect}'s poems aloud at court and claimed they were their own.
{victim} says he is close to proving that {suspect} is plotting against the crown.
{suspect} says {victim} has the King wrapped around her finger, and the whole realm with him.
{suspect} fears that {victim} will strip them of their lands as soon as he is king.
{suspect} says {victim} lets the common people starve while he feasts.
{victim} promised {suspect} a seat on the royal council, then gave it to someone else.
{victim} had {suspect} thrown out of court in front of everyone.
{victim} still laughs at {suspect} for missing the stag at the last royal hunt.
{victim} knows {suspect} forged the King's seal on a royal decree.
{victim} called {suspect} a tasteless fool, in front of the whole kitchen.
{suspect} supports the new reforms, and {victim} has sworn to block them as long as he commands the guard.
{suspect} owes {victim} a fortune for a sword he made, and {victim} wants every coin by tomorrow.
{victim} keeps a record of every book {suspect} borrowed, and some of those books are forbidden.
{suspect} lost a fortune to {victim} at cards this morning, and {victim} wants it paid tonight.
{victim} caught {suspect} with a royal ring in their pocket this morning, and will report it tomorrow.
{suspect} said this morning that {victim} will pay for what happened to their brother.
Letter from {victim} to the King: "{suspect} is having a secret affair. You deserve to know."
{victim} searched {suspect}'s things this morning and found something. {suspect} went white as a sheet.
{victim} refused to treat {suspect}'s sick sister in the village this morning. She's only getting worse.
{victim} told the King this morning that {suspect} is unfit to rule. And the King listened.
The whole hallway heard {suspect} and {victim} shouting this morning. {suspect} yelled: 'Over my dead body. Or yours!'
{victim} ordered {suspect} to be locked up on the village square tomorrow, for the whole village to throw rotten eggs at.
{victim} cut {suspect}'s wages in half this morning.
{victim} banned {suspect} from the library for good this morning, in front of everyone.
{victim} beat {suspect} at swordplay this morning, in front of the whole court, and laughed.
{suspect} asked {victim} to marry them this morning. {victim} laughed out loud.
{victim} served {suspect} spoiled fish this morning, as revenge for a complaint. {suspect} was ill all morning.
{victim} arrested {suspect}'s nephew in the village this morning. The boy might be banished from the kingdom.
{suspect} saw {victim} tearing pages out of the oldest book in the library this morning.
{victim} poured {suspect}'s finest bottle of wine out of the window this morning.
